extras.notes: front faces -Y; generic boxy 1980s notchback sedan with flat rectangular headlights and black plastic bumpers; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, seats, rear bench and steering wheel; no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
